demos.name: Agent Privilege K8 Kits
demos.description: Download hub for the Agent Privilege Gateway Kubernetes deployment kits: the single-gateway quick-start package and the multi-gateway HA package (shared Redis, integrated load balancer), plus the shared 18-page deployment guide served inline. Read-only artifact server; offline; no tenant.
demos.notes: Serves packaged zips + PDF from its own kits/ and docs/ folders. Swap a kit, run ./checksums.sh, npm test. Port 7809 loopback-only; lab-proxy path /privilege-k8-kits/.
